draft.title: 一起UNO！
draft.playNote: 经典的四人UNO桌面卡牌游戏，支持与小手机内的AI角色或同伴一同游玩。包含红黄蓝绿四色数字牌、跳过(Skip)、转向(Reverse)、罚摸两张(Draw 2)、变色(Wild)与罚摸四张(Wild Draw 4)全套规则。游戏进入后自适应横屏显示，支持出剩1张牌时喊UNO、AI对手性格打牌台词互动，并在对局结束时自动生成战局总结写入角色记忆。
draft.gameHtml:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>四人UNO对决</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #0f172a; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #fff; }
    #orient-wrapper { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1e293b 0%, #090d16 100%); }
    .table-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 72px 1fr 125px; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 140px; padding: 8px 16px; }
    .player-seat { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); z-index: 10; }
    .player-seat.active-turn { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.24); border-color: #f59e0b; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6), inset 0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); transform: scale(1.05); animation: turnPulse 1.6s infinite alternate ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes turnPulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.75), 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); } }
    .seat-top { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 2; justify-self: center; align-self: start; }
    .seat-left { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 1; justify-self: start; align-self: center; flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    .seat-right { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 3; justify-self: end; align-self: center; flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    /* 允许快捷发言菜单溢出显示，不再被裁剪 */
    .seat-bottom { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 1 / span 3; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0 4px 4px 4px; min-width: 0; width: 100%; height: 120px; overflow: visible; box-sizing: border-box; }
    .avatar-wrapper { position: relative; width: 46px; height: 46px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: visible; transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper { cursor: pointer; }
    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }
    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:hover .avatar-box { border-color: #38bdf8; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5); }
    .player-seat .avatar-wrapper:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    .avatar-box { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); overflow: hidden; background: #334155; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; }
    .avatar-box img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
    .uno-badge { position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626); color: #ffffff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; font-style: italic; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid #fef08a; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6); animation: bounce 0.55s infinite alternate; display: none; z-index: 25; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; }
    @keyframes bounce { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(-4px); } }
    .seat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 90px; overflow: hidden; }
    .seat-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow: hidden; }
    .seat-count { font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .card-mini-icon { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 14px; background: #ef4444; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #fff; }
    .speech-bubble { position: absolute; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); color: #f8fafc; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); z-index: 60; min-width: 90px; max-width: 250px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow: visible; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .speech-bubble.show { opacity: 1; }
    .seat-top .speech-bubble { top: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.92); }
    .seat-top .speech-bubble.show { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); }
    .seat-top .speech-bubble::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); border-left: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); }
    .seat-left .speech-bubble { left: calc(100% + 12px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92); }
    .seat-left .speech-bubble.show { transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }
    .seat-left .speech-bubble::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -5px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); border-top: 5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); }
    .seat-right .speech-bubble { right: calc(100% + 12px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92); }
    .seat-right .speech-bubble.show { transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }
    .seat-right .speech-bubble::before { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -5px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); border-top: 5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 5px solid transparent; border-left: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); }
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble { left: 10px; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.92); }
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble.show { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    .seat-bottom .speech-bubble::before { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: -5px; left: 20px; border-left: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 5px solid transparent; border-top: 5px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); }
    .center-board { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 2; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; }
    .direction-ring { position: absolute; width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); pointer-events: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.8s ease-in-out; }
    .direction-ring::before { content: "➔"; position: absolute; top: -12px; font-size: 20px; color: #38bdf8; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #38bdf8); }
    .direction-ring::after { content: "➔"; position: absolute; bottom: -12px; font-size: 20px; color: #38bdf8; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #38bdf8); transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .direction-ring.reverse { transform: scaleX(-1); }
    .active-color-glow { position: absolute; width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(28px); opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; transition: background 0.4s; }
    .color-red { background: #ef4444 !important; }
    .color-yellow { background: #eab308 !important; }
    .color-green { background: #22c55e !important; }
    .color-blue { background: #3b82f6 !important; }
    .color-black { background: #1e293b !important; }
    .uno-card { position: relative; width: 68px; height: 98px; border-radius: 9px; background: #ffffff; border: 3px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.18s; overflow: hidden; }
    .uno-card.playable:hover { transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.7); z-index: 25; }
    .uno-card.playable { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); cursor: pointer; }
    .uno-card.disabled { opacity: 0.55; filter: grayscale(0.2); cursor: not-allowed; }
    .card-inner { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; }
    .card-oval { position: absolute; width: 54px; height: 82px; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(26deg); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); pointer-events: none; }
    .card-num { position: relative; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 900; font-style: italic; color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); z-index: 2; }
    .card-corner { position: absolute; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; font-style: italic; z-index: 2; }
    .card-corner.tl { top: 2px; left: 4px; }
    .card-corner.br { bottom: 2px; right: 4px; transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .deck-pile { position: relative; width: 68px; height: 98px; border-radius: 9px; background: #0f172a; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: -4px 5px 0px #334155, -8px 10px 0px #1e293b; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .deck-pile:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    .deck-logo { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: #ef4444; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #fbbf24; font-style: italic; }
    .deck-count { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 4px; }
    .player-hand-container { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
    .hand-cards-scroll { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: visible; padding: 24px 14px 6px 14px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2) transparent; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
    .hand-cards-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 4px; }
    .hand-cards-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 4px; }
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; transition: margin-right 0.25s ease, transform 0.2s ease, z-index 0.1s; }
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:hover, .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:focus-within, .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper.touch-active { z-index: 60 !important; transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.14); }
    .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper:hover .uno-card, .hand-cards-scroll .card-wrapper.touch-active .uno-card { box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
    .player-controls { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .btn-uno { padding: 8px 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #b91c1c); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; font-style: italic; border: 2px solid #fef08a; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5); cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; transition: all 0.2s; }
    .btn-uno:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
    .btn-uno.highlight { animation: pulse-uno 0.5s infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes pulse-uno { from { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ef4444; } to { transform: scale(1.12); box-shadow: 0 0 20px #f59e0b, 0 0 30px #ef4444; } }
    .btn-pass { padding: 6px 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: none; }
    /* 快捷发言按钮 */
    .btn-quick { padding: 8px 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6, #7c3aed); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 18px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .btn-quick:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
    /* 快捷发言菜单 —— 改为在按钮左侧垂直居中弹出，避免被遮挡 */
    .quick-speak-menu {
      position: absolute;
      right: calc(100% + 10px);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.97);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.55);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 16px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      z-index: 145;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .quick-speak-menu.show {
      display: flex;
      animation: quickMenuIn 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }
    @keyframes quickMenuIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.85); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }
    }
    .quick-speak-btn { padding: 7px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 10px; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; text-align: center; }
    .quick-speak-btn:hover { background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.32); border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.65); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .quick-speak-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    .react-popover { position: absolute; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); border: 1.5px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5); border-radius: 30px; padding: 4px 8px; display: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 0 16px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); z-index: 140; animation: popIn 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); white-space: nowrap; }
    .react-popover.show { display: flex; }
    @keyframes popIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
    .seat-top .react-popover { top: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    .seat-left .react-popover { left: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .seat-right .react-popover { right: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .seat-bottom .react-popover { bottom: calc(100% + 10px); left: 10px; }
    .react-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 21px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s; }
    .react-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.3); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); }
    .react-btn:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
    .player-seat { cursor: pointer; }
    .player-seat:hover { border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25); }
    .burst-emoji { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.2); font-size: 42px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 80; opacity: 0; animation: burstAnim 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28) forwards; }
    @keyframes burstAnim { 0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.2); opacity: 0; } 25% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.3); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)); } 60% { transform: translate(-50%, -65%) scale(1.05); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -85%) scale(0.8); opacity: 0; } }
    .color-picker-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 100; }
    .challenge-modal-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 180; padding: 16px; }
    .challenge-modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
    .challenge-card { background: #1e293b; border: 2px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px 22px; max-width: 440px; width: 100%; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35); animation: popIn 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); }
    .challenge-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; color: #f87171; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
    .challenge-desc { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #cbd5e1; margin-bottom: 14px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; }
    .challenge-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-challenge-yes { flex: 1; padding: 10px 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .btn-challenge-no { flex: 1; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); color: #e2e8f0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .btn-challenge-yes:active, .btn-challenge-no:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    .color-picker-overlay.show { display: flex; }
    .picker-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 20px; text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
    .picker-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
    .picker-btn { width: 78px; height: 78px; border-radius: 18px; border: 3px solid #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
    .picker-btn:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
    .modal-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 200; padding: 20px; }
    .modal-card { background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px 24px; max-width: 520px; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; }
    .modal-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #ef4444); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .modal-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .char-select-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(130px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; max-height: 180px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px; }
    .char-card { position: relative; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; }
    .char-card.selected { border-color: #f59e0b; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); }
    .char-card.selected::after { content: "✓ 已选"; position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; color: #f59e0b; }
    .char-card img, .char-card .avatar-fallback { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: #334155; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; object-fit: cover; }
    .char-card-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .btn-start { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #1d4ed8); color: #fff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); transition: transform 0.15s; }
    .btn-start:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
    .toast-msg { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: #f8fafc; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s; z-index: 150; white-space: nowrap; }
    .toast-msg.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(6px); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div id="orient-wrapper">
    <div class="table-container">
      
      <div style="grid-row: 1; grid-column: 3; justify-self: end; align-self: start; z-index: 20;">
        <button id="btn-speed-toggle" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 20px; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);">
          💬 节奏: 互动沉浸
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="seat-top" class="player-seat seat-top">
        <div class="avatar-wrapper" data-seat="2">
          <div class="avatar-box">
            <span id="avatar-top-text">2</span>
            <img id="avatar-top-img" style="display:none;" alt="">
          </div>
          <div id="uno-badge-top" class="uno-badge">UNO!</div>
        </div>
        <div class="seat-info">
          <div id="name-top" class="seat-name">玩家2</div>

  <script>
    /* =========================================================
       1. 自适应横屏逻辑
       ========================================================= */
    function adaptOrientation() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      const h = window.innerHeight;
      const wrapper = document.getElementById('orient-wrapper');
      if (!wrapper) return;
      if (w < h) {
        wrapper.style.width = h + 'px';
        wrapper.style.height = w + 'px';
        wrapper.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
        wrapper.style.transform = 'matrix(0, 1, -1, 0, ' + w + ', 0)';
      } else {
        wrapper.style.width = '100%';
        wrapper.style.height = '100%';
        wrapper.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
        wrapper.style.transform = 'none';
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', adaptOrientation);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', adaptOrientation);
    adaptOrientation();
    try {
      if (screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) {
        screen.orientation.lock('landscape').catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch(e) {}

    /* =========================================================
       2. Web Audio API 音效
       ========================================================= */
    let audioCtx = null;
    function getAudioContext() {
      if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
      return audioCtx;
    }
    function playSound(type) {
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioContext();
        if (!ctx) return;
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        const now = ctx.currentTime;
        if (type === 'play') {
          osc.type = 'sine';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.1);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.12);
          osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.12);
        } else if (type === 'draw') {
          osc.type = 'triangle';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, now);
          osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(180, now + 0.1);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.1);
          osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.1);
        } else if (type === 'uno') {
          osc.type = 'square';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now);
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.08);
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.16);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.35);
          osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.35);
        } else if (type === 'win') {
          [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((freq, i) => {
            const o = ctx.createOscillator();
            const g = ctx.createGain();
            o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
            o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.1);
            g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now + i * 0.1);
            g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.1 + 0.4);
            o.start(now + i * 0.1); o.stop(now + i * 0.1 + 0.4);
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    /* =========================================================
       3. UNO 牌库定义
       ========================================================= */
    const COLORS = ['red', 'yellow', 'green', 'blue'];
    const SPECIAL_TYPES = ['skip', 'reverse', 'draw2'];

    function createDeck() {
      const deck = [];
      let uid = 1;
      COLORS.forEach(color => {
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: 0 });
        for (let v = 1; v <= 9; v++) {
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: v });
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type: 'number', value: v });
        }
        SPECIAL_TYPES.forEach(type => {
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type, value: type });
          deck.push({ id: uid++, color, type, value: type });
        });
      });
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color: 'black', type: 'wild', value: 'W' });
        deck.push({ id: uid++, color: 'black', type: 'wild_draw4', value: '+4' });
      }
      for (let i = deck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [deck[i], deck[j]] = [deck[j], deck[i]];
      }
      return deck;
    }

    function sortCardsByColor(cards) {
      const colorOrder = { red: 0, yellow: 1, green: 2, blue: 3, black: 4 };
      const valOrder = { skip: 10, reverse: 11, draw2: 12, wild: 13, wild_draw4: 14 };
      return cards.slice().sort((a, b) => {
        if (colorOrder[a.color] !== colorOrder[b.color]) {
          return colorOrder[a.color] - colorOrder[b.color];
        }
        const valA = typeof a.value === 'number' ? a.value : (valOrder[a.value] || 20);
        const valB = typeof b.value === 'number' ? b.value : (valOrder[b.value] || 20);
        return valA - valB;
      });
    }

    /* =========================================================
       4. 游戏主状态机

      drawPile: [],
      discardPile: [],

      gameSpeed: 'immersive' // 'immersive' | 'fast'

    function showToast(text) {

    /* =========================================================
       5. 宿主 API 联动与选人引擎
       ========================================================= */
    let playerProfile = { name: "我", avatar: null };
    let availableChars = [];
    let selectedCharIds = [];

    async function initHostServices() {
      let savedCustomAvatar = null;
      try {
        savedCustomAvatar = localStorage.getItem('uno_user_permanent_avatar') || localStorage.getItem('aiphone_user_custom_avatar');
      } catch (e) {}

      if (window.AiPhoneGame) {
        try {
          await AiPhoneGame.setTitleBar({
            buttonBackground: "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)",
            buttonColor: "#38bdf8",
            buttonBorderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)",
            buttonRadius: "999px",
            iconOpacity: 0.95
          });
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const save = await AiPhoneGame.loadGame();
          if (save && save.customAvatar) savedCustomAvatar = save.customAvatar;
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const p = await AiPhoneGame.getPlayerProfile();
          if (p) {
            if (p.name) playerProfile.name = p.name;
            if (!savedCustomAvatar) {
              const hostAvatar = p.avatar || p.avatarUrl || p.icon || p.image || p.headImg || p.photo;
              if (hostAvatar) playerProfile.avatar = hostAvatar;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const list = await AiPhoneGame.listAvailableCharacters();
          if (Array.isArray(list)) availableChars = list;
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (savedCustomAvatar) playerProfile.avatar = savedCustomAvatar;

      updateUserProfilePreview();
      bindAvatarUpload();
      renderCharSelection();
    }

    function updateUserProfilePreview() {
      const pName = document.getElementById('user-preview-name');
      const pImg = document.getElementById('user-preview-img');
      const pText = document.getElementById('user-preview-text');
      if (pName) pName.innerText = playerProfile.name;
      if (playerProfile.avatar) {
        if (pImg) { pImg.src = playerProfile.avatar; pImg.style.display = 'block'; }
        if (pText) pText.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        if (pImg) pImg.style.display = 'none';
        if (pText) {
          pText.innerText = (playerProfile.name || "我").slice(0, 1);
          pText.style.display = 'block';
        }
      }
    }

    function bindAvatarUpload() {
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('user-avatar-file-input');
      const clickBox = document.getElementById('user-avatar-click-box');
      const triggerBtn = document.getElementById('btn-upload-avatar-trigger');
      if (clickBox && fileInput) clickBox.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
      if (triggerBtn && fileInput) triggerBtn.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
      if (fileInput) {
        fileInput.onchange = (e) => {
          const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
          if (!file) return;
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = (event) => {
            const base64Url = event.target.result;
            playerProfile.avatar = base64Url;
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('uno_user_permanent_avatar', base64Url);
              localStorage.setItem('aiphone_user_custom_avatar', base64Url);
            } catch (err) {}
            if (window.AiPhoneGame && typeof AiPhoneGame.saveGame === 'function') {
              AiPhoneGame.saveGame({ customAvatar: base64Url }).catch(() => {});
            }
            updateUserProfilePreview();
            showToast("📷 成功保存专属头像，以后每次进入都会自动保留！");
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        };
      }
    }

    function renderCharSelection() {
      const listEl = document.getElementById('char-list');
      listEl.innerHTML = '';
      const defaults = [
        { id: "npc_1", name: "阿澈", subtitle: "沉稳冷静的推演派" },
        { id: "npc_2", name: "小悠", subtitle: "元气满满的乐天派" },
        { id: "npc_3", name: "凌风", subtitle: "热血战术的大师" }
      ];
      const allOptions = [...(availableChars || [])];
      defaults.forEach(d => {
        if (!allOptions.some(c => c.name === d.name)) allOptions.push(d);
      });
      if (!selectedCharIds || selectedCharIds.length === 0) {
        selectedCharIds = allOptions.slice(0, 3).map(c => c.id);
      }
      const countEl = document.getElementById('char-count-pill');
      const startBtn = document.getElementById('btn-confirm-start');
      if (countEl) {
        countEl.innerText = `已选 ${selectedCharIds.length}/3 人`;
        countEl.style.color = selectedCharIds.length === 3 ? '#22c55e' : '#f59e0b';
      }
      if (startBtn) {
        if (selectedCharIds.length === 3) {
          startBtn.innerText = "进入对局";
          startBtn.style.opacity = "1";
          startBtn.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
        } else {
          startBtn.innerText = `请勾选满 3 人 (还差 ${3 - selectedCharIds.length} 人)`;
          startBtn.style.opacity = "0.6";
          startBtn.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        }
      }
      allOptions.forEach(char => {
        const isSelected = selectedCharIds.includes(char.id);
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'char-card' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '');
        item.innerHTML = `
          ${char.avatar ? `<img src="${char.avatar}" alt="">` : `<div class="avatar-fallback">${char.name[0]}</div>`}
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;">

          </div>
        `;
        item.onclick = () => {
          if (selectedCharIds.includes(char.id)) {
            selectedCharIds = selectedCharIds.filter(id => id !== char.id);
          } else {
            if (selectedCharIds.length < 3) {
              selectedCharIds.push(char.id);
            } else {
              selectedCharIds.shift();
              selectedCharIds.push(char.id);
            }
          }
          renderCharSelection();
        };
        listEl.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    /* =========================================================
       6. 启动游戏与发牌
       ========================================================= */
    function startGame() {
      document.getElementById('modal-intro').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('modal-gameover').style.display = 'none';
      const chosenChars = [];
      selectedCharIds.forEach(id => {
        const found = (availableChars || []).find(c => c.id === id) || { id, name: id.startsWith('npc') ? (id === 'npc_1' ? '阿澈' : id === 'npc_2' ? '小悠' : '凌风') : '同伴' };
        chosenChars.push(found);
      });
      while (chosenChars.length < 3) {
        chosenChars.push({ id: "npc_" + chosenChars.length, name: "牌友" + (chosenChars.length + 1) });
      }
      GAME.players = [
        { id: "human", name: playerProfile.name, avatar: playerProfile.avatar, emojiAvatar: playerProfile.emojiAvatar, isAI: false, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[0].id, name: chosenChars[0].name, avatar: chosenChars[0].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[1].id, name: chosenChars[1].name, avatar: chosenChars[1].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false },
        { id: chosenChars[2].id, name: chosenChars[2].name, avatar: chosenChars[2].avatar, isAI: true, cards: [], uno: false }
      ];
      updateSeatUIHeader(0, GAME.players[0], 'avatar-player-text', 'avatar-player-img', 'name-player');
      updateSeatUIHeader(1, GAME.players[1], 'avatar-left-text', 'avatar-left-img', 'name-left');
      updateSeatUIHeader(2, GAME.players[2], 'avatar-top-text', 'avatar-top-img', 'name-top');
      updateSeatUIHeader(3, GAME.players[3], 'avatar-right-text', 'avatar-right-img', 'name-right');

      GAME.drawPile = createDeck();
      GAME.discardPile = [];
      GAME.direction = 1;
      GAME.currentTurn = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
      GAME.playerUnoShouted = false;
      GAME.hasDrawnThisTurn = false;
      GAME.isProcessing = false;
      GAME.gameActive = true;

      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        GAME.players.forEach(p => p.cards.push(GAME.drawPile.pop()));
      }
      GAME.players.forEach(p => { p.cards = sortCardsByColor(p.cards); });

      let firstCard = GAME.drawPile.pop();
      while (firstCard.type === 'wild_draw4') {
        GAME.drawPile.unshift(firstCard);
        firstCard = GAME.drawPile.pop();
      }
      GAME.discardPile.push(firstCard);
      GAME.currentColor = firstCard.color === 'black' ? COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)] : firstCard.color;

      playSound('draw');
      const starterName = GAME.currentTurn === 0 ? "你" : `【${GAME.players[GAME.currentTurn].name}】`;
      showToast(`🎲 随机先手：本局由 ${starterName} 先出牌！底牌是【${getCardDesc(firstCard)}】`);

    }

    /* =========================================================
       7. 牌面渲染与出牌判断
       ========================================================= */
    function getCardDesc(card) {
      const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝", black: "万能" };
      const valNames = { skip: "跳过", reverse: "转向", draw2: "+2", wild: "变色", wild_draw4: "+4" };
      return `${colorNames[card.color] || ""}${valNames[card.value] !== undefined ? valNames[card.value] : card.value}`;
    }

    function canPlayCard(card) {
      const topCard = GAME.discardPile[GAME.discardPile.length - 1];
      if (!topCard) return true;
      if (card.color === 'black') return true;
      if (card.color === GAME.currentColor) return true;
      if (card.type === 'number' && topCard.type === 'number' && card.value === topCard.value) return true;
      if (card.type !== 'number' && card.type === topCard.type &&
          (card.type === 'skip' || card.type === 'reverse' || card.type === 'draw2')) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    function renderCardHTML(card, isPlayable = false) {
      let bgClass = 'color-' + card.color;
      let displayValue = card.value;
      if (card.type === 'skip') displayValue = '⊘';
      if (card.type === 'reverse') displayValue = '⇄';
      if (card.type === 'draw2') displayValue = '+2';
      if (card.type === 'wild') displayValue = '🌈';
      if (card.type === 'wild_draw4') displayValue = '+4';
      return `
        <div class="uno-card ${isPlayable ? 'playable' : 'disabled'}">
          <div class="card-inner ${bgClass}">
            <div class="card-oval"></div>
            <div class="card-corner tl">${displayValue}</div>
            <div class="card-num">${displayValue}</div>
            <div class="card-corner br">${displayValue}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderBoard() {
      const topCard = GAME.discardPile[GAME.discardPile.length - 1];
      const discardEl = document.getElementById('discard-pile');
      if (topCard) discardEl.innerHTML = renderCardHTML(topCard, false);

      document.getElementById('deck-count-text').innerText = GAME.drawPile.length;
      const glow = document.getElementById('color-glow');
      glow.className = `active-color-glow color-${GAME.currentColor}`;

      const countIds = ['count-player', 'count-left', 'count-top', 'count-right'];
      const unoIds = ['uno-badge-player', 'uno-badge-left', 'uno-badge-top', 'uno-badge-right'];

      GAME.players.forEach((p, idx) => {
        const seatEl = document.getElementById(seatIds[idx]);
        if (seatEl) {
          if (idx === GAME.currentTurn) seatEl.classList.add('active-turn');
          else seatEl.classList.remove('active-turn');
        }

        document.getElementById(unoIds[idx]).style.display = p.cards.length === 1 ? 'block' : 'none';
      });

      const handContainer = document.getElementById('player-cards');
      handContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const isMyTurn = (GAME.currentTurn === 0 && GAME.gameActive && !GAME.isProcessing);
      const myCards = GAME.players[0].cards;
      const totalCards = myCards.length;

      let cardMarginRight = -24;
      if (totalCards > 16) cardMarginRight = -50;
      else if (totalCards > 12) cardMarginRight = -44;
      else if (totalCards > 8) cardMarginRight = -36;
      else if (totalCards > 5) cardMarginRight = -28;

      myCards.forEach((card, idx) => {
        const playable = isMyTurn && canPlayCard(card);
        const cardWrapper = document.createElement('div');
        cardWrapper.className = 'card-wrapper';
        cardWrapper.style.zIndex = (totalCards + 20 - idx);
        if (idx !== totalCards - 1) cardWrapper.style.marginRight = cardMarginRight + 'px';

          cardWrapper.onclick = () => playerPlayCard(card);

          cardWrapper.classList.add('touch-active');
        }, { passive: true });
        handContainer.appendChild(cardWrapper);
      });

    /* =========================================================
       8. 回合驱动
       ========================================================= */
    function triggerTurn() {
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
      GAME.isProcessing = false;
      GAME.hasDrawnThisTurn = false;
      renderBoard();

      const curIndex = GAME.currentTurn;
      const curPlayer = GAME.players[curIndex];

      if (curIndex === 0) {
        showToast("轮到你出牌了！");
      } else {
        showToast(`轮到【${curPlayer.name}】出牌…`);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!GAME.gameActive || GAME.currentTurn !== curIndex || GAME.isProcessing) return;
          handleAITurn(curIndex);
        }, getDelay(1000));
      }
    }

    function advanceTurn(skipSteps = 1) {
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
      const total = GAME.players.length;
      GAME.currentTurn = (GAME.currentTurn + GAME.direction * skipSteps + total * 10) % total;
      GAME.isProcessing = false;
      renderBoard();
      setTimeout(() => { triggerTurn(); }, getDelay(450));
    }

    function drawCardForPlayer(playerIndex, count = 1) {
      const cardsDrawn = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (GAME.drawPile.length === 0) {
          if (GAME.discardPile.length <= 1) break;
          const topCard = GAME.discardPile.pop();
          GAME.drawPile = [...GAME.discardPile];
          GAME.discardPile = [topCard];
          for (let k = GAME.drawPile.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (k + 1));
            [GAME.drawPile[k], GAME.drawPile[j]] = [GAME.drawPile[j], GAME.drawPile[k]];
          }
          showToast("牌堆已重新洗匀");
        }
        const card = GAME.drawPile.pop();
        if (card) {
          GAME.players[playerIndex].cards.push(card);
          cardsDrawn.push(card);
        }
      }
      GAME.players[playerIndex].cards = sortCardsByColor(GAME.players[playerIndex].cards);
      playSound('draw');
      return cardsDrawn;
    }

    async function applyCardEffect(playerIndex, card, chosenColor = null) {
      if (GAME.isProcessing) return;
      GAME.isProcessing = true;

      const p = GAME.players[playerIndex];
      const prevColor = GAME.currentColor;
      const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝" };

      const hadMatchingColorBefore = p.cards.some(c => c.color === prevColor && c.id !== card.id);

      const cardIdx = p.cards.findIndex(c => c.id === card.id);
      if (cardIdx !== -1) p.cards.splice(cardIdx, 1);
      p.cards = sortCardsByColor(p.cards);

      GAME.discardPile.push(card);
      playSound('play');

      if (card.color === 'black') {
        GAME.currentColor = chosenColor || COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
      } else {
        GAME.currentColor = card.color;
      }

      if (p.cards.length === 1) {
        p.uno = true;
        playSound('uno');
        await aiSpeak(playerIndex, "我只剩最后一张牌了，大喊一声 UNO！向全场宣告绝杀时刻！");
        showToast(`⚠️ 警报！${p.name} 仅剩最后 1 张手牌并喊了 UNO!`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));
      } else {
        p.uno = false;
      }

      if (p.cards.length === 0) {
        renderBoard();
        handleGameOver(playerIndex);
        return;
      }

      if (card.type === 'wild_draw4') {
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        renderBoard();
        await handleWild4Challenge(playerIndex, targetIdx, hadMatchingColorBefore, GAME.currentColor, prevColor);
        return;
      }

      let nextSkip = 1;

      if (card.type === 'reverse') {
        GAME.direction *= -1;
        showToast(`🔄 ${p.name} 打出【转向】，出牌方向逆转！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2000)));
      } else if (card.type === 'skip') {
        nextSkip = 2;
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const target = GAME.players[targetIdx];
        showToast(`🚫 ${p.name} 打出【跳过】！${target.name} 被暂停本轮！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));
        await aiSpeak(targetIdx, `我被【${p.name}】的跳过牌击中，被迫轮空一轮，很不甘心。`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2200)));
      } else if (card.type === 'draw2') {
        nextSkip = 2;
        const targetIdx = (playerIndex + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const target = GAME.players[targetIdx];
        drawCardForPlayer(targetIdx, 2);
        showToast(`💥 ${p.name} 打出【+2】！${target.name} 罚摸 2 张并被跳过！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1200)));
        await aiSpeak(targetIdx, `我被【${p.name}】打出的+2命中，被迫摸了2张牌并被跳过，十分痛苦。`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2400)));
      } else if (card.type === 'wild') {
        const colText = colorNames[GAME.currentColor] || "指定";
        showToast(`🌈 ${p.name} 打出了万能牌，将颜色变为了【${colText}色】！`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1800)));
      } else {
        showToast(`${p.name} 打出了【${getCardDesc(card)}】`);
        renderBoard();
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1600)));
      }

      advanceTurn(nextSkip);
    }

      const fromPlayer = GAME.players[fromSeat];
      const targetPlayer = GAME.players[targetSeat];

      if (didChallenge) {

          renderBoard();

        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1800)));
        advanceTurn(2);
      }
    }

      const map = {
        '💣': ['别生气嘛', '不用谢~', '嘻嘻', '冷静冷静', '哈哈哈'],
        '🌹': ['谢谢你🌹', '太客气了', '收到~', '承让承让'],
        '😡': ['消消气', '我错了嘛', '别急别急', '冷静一下'],
        '👍': ['谢谢夸奖', '继续继续', '过奖了', '一起加油'],
        '😭': ['别哭啦', '加油', '下次让着你', '别难过嘛']
      };
      const arr = map[emoji] || ['嗯嗯', '收到~', '好的好的'];
      return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------
       用户快捷发言 → AI 角色快捷回应短语（快速模式专用）
       --------------------------------------------------------- */
    function getAISpeakReplyToUser(text) {
      const map = {
        '谢谢你': ['不用谢~', '客气了', '应该的', '嘻嘻', '举手之劳'],
        '气死我了': ['消消气', '别急别急', '冷静一下', '哈哈哈哈'],
        '666': ['谢谢夸奖', '过奖了', '😎', '还行吧', '嘻嘻'],
        '干得漂亮': ['谢谢', '过奖了', '小意思', '承让了', '多多指教'],
        '最后一张！': ['别得意', '看我的', '呵', '不一定哦', '别急嘛', '走着瞧']
      };
      const arr = map[text] || ['嗯嗯', '收到~', '好的'];
      return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
    }

    /* =========================================================
       11. 发言系统
       ========================================================= */
    async function aiSpeak(seatIndex, context) {
      const p = GAME.players[seatIndex];
      if (!p) return;

      if (seatIndex === 0) {
        showSpeech(0, context.slice(0, 16));
        return;
      }

      if (GAME.gameSpeed === 'fast') {
        const phrase = pickQuickPhrase(context);
        showSpeech(seatIndex, phrase);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));
        return;
      }

      showSpeech(seatIndex, "发言中…");

      const tableRules = `我们正在一起打四人UNO桌游。你是玩家【${p.name}】。牌桌上的其他AI选手均为线上随机匹配到的陌生路人玩家，彼此不认识。请严格根据人设，对发生的客观事实做出反应。严禁使用熟人或亲昵语气，保持面对陌生牌友的正常社交距离。要求：必须直接输出你的台词，绝对不要带【】前缀，不要加动作描写或旁白，控制在15个字以内。`;

      if (window.AiPhoneGame && p.id && !p.id.startsWith('npc_')) {
        try {
          const pkg = await AiPhoneGame.getRoleLightPackage(p.id);
          const res = await AiPhoneGame.callLLM({
            characterId: p.id,
            messages: [
              ...(pkg.messages || []),
              { role: 'system', content: tableRules },
              { role: 'user', content: `[当前客观事实：${context}]` }
            ]
          });
          if (res && res.content) {
            const clean = res.content.trim().replace(/^["'“‘「（(]|["'”’」）)]$/g, '').replace(/^[（(].*?[）)]/g, '');
            if (clean.length > 0) { showSpeech(seatIndex, clean); return; }
          }
        } catch (e) { console.error("AI发言失败:", e); }
      } else if (window.AiPhoneGame && typeof AiPhoneGame.callGlobalLLM === 'function') {
        try {
          const npcPersona = p.id === 'npc_1'
            ? '你是线上随机匹配到的路人玩家阿澈，性格冷静严谨、讲究推演计算，对陌生人礼貌克制。'
            : p.id === 'npc_2'
            ? '你是线上随机匹配到的路人玩家小悠，性格元气活泼、爱笑搞怪，是个自来熟但不越界的陌生牌友。'
            : '你是线上随机匹配到的路人玩家凌风，性格热血中二、狂傲好胜，喜欢对陌生对手放中二狠话。';
          const res = await AiPhoneGame.callGlobalLLM({
            messages: [
              { role: 'system', content: `${npcPersona}\n${tableRules}` },
              { role: 'user', content: `[当前客观事实：${context}]` }
            ]
          });
          if (res && res.content) {
            const clean = res.content.trim().replace(/^["'“‘「（(]|["'”’」）)]$/g, '').replace(/^[（(].*?[）)]/g, '');
            if (clean.length > 0) { showSpeech(seatIndex, clean); return; }
          }
        } catch (e) { console.error("内置AI发言失败:", e); }
      }

      const bubble = document.getElementById(['bubble-player', 'bubble-left', 'bubble-top', 'bubble-right'][seatIndex]);
      if (bubble) bubble.classList.remove('show');
    }

    /* =========================================================
       12. AI 回合驱动
       ========================================================= */
    async function handleAITurn(aiIndex) {
      const ai = GAME.players[aiIndex];
      showSpeech(aiIndex, "正在选牌…");
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1300)));
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

      const validCards = ai.cards.filter(c => canPlayCard(c));

      if (validCards.length > 0) {
        validCards.sort((a, b) => {
          const score = c => (c.type === 'wild_draw4' ? 10 : c.type === 'draw2' ? 8 : c.type === 'skip' ? 7 : c.type === 'reverse' ? 6 : c.type === 'wild' ? 5 : 2);
          return score(b) - score(a);
        });
        const chosenCard = validCards[0];
        let chosenColor = null;

        if (chosenCard.color === 'black') {
          const counts = { red: 0, yellow: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 };
          ai.cards.forEach(c => { if (counts[c.color] !== undefined) counts[c.color]++; });
          chosenColor = Object.keys(counts).reduce((a, b) => counts[a] > counts[b] ? a : b);
        }

        const colorNames = { red: "红", yellow: "黄", green: "绿", blue: "蓝" };
        const cardDesc = getCardDesc(chosenCard);
        const targetIdx = (GAME.players.indexOf(ai) + GAME.direction + 4) % 4;
        const targetPlayer = GAME.players[targetIdx];

        await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `打出了一张【${cardDesc}】${chosenCard.color === 'black' ? `(指定为${colorNames[chosenColor]}色)` : ''}，下家是【${targetPlayer.name}】`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(2000)));
        if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

        await applyCardEffect(aiIndex, chosenCard, chosenColor);
      } else {
        await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `手里没有合规的牌，摸一张`);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1600)));
        if (!GAME.gameActive) return;

        const drawn = drawCardForPlayer(aiIndex, 1);
        renderBoard();
        if (drawn.length > 0 && canPlayCard(drawn[0])) {
          await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `运气真好，刚摸到的【${getCardDesc(drawn[0])}】正好能打出`);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1800)));
          if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
          let chosenColor = null;
          if (drawn[0].color === 'black') chosenColor = COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
          await applyCardEffect(aiIndex, drawn[0], chosenColor);
        } else {
          await aiSpeak(aiIndex, `摸了依然没有能出的牌，过牌给下家`);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, getDelay(1400)));
          advanceTurn(1);
        }
      }
    }

    /* =========================================================
       13. 游戏结束
       ========================================================= */
    function handleGameOver(winnerIdx) {
      GAME.gameActive = false;
      GAME.isProcessing = false;
      playSound('win');
      const winner = GAME.players[winnerIdx];
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-gameover');
      const titleEl = document.getElementById('gameover-title');
      const descEl = document.getElementById('gameover-desc');
      const sumEl = document.getElementById('gameover-summary');
      titleEl.innerText = winnerIdx === 0 ? "🎉 你赢了！" : `😢 ${winner.name} 获胜`;
      descEl.innerText = winnerIdx === 0 ? "恭喜你率先出完所有手牌！" : "再接再厉，下局一定赢！";
      let html = '';
      GAME.players.forEach((p, i) => {
        html += `<div>${i === 0 ? '你' : p.name}：剩余 ${p.cards.length} 张${p.uno ? '（已喊 UNO!）' : ''}</div>`;
      });
      sumEl.innerHTML = html;
      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    /* =========================================================
       14. 用户快捷发言
       ========================================================= */
    let lastQuickSpeakTime = 0;
    async function onUserQuickSpeak(text) {
      if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastQuickSpeakTime < 1500) return;
      lastQuickSpeakTime = now;

      showSpeech(0, text);
      playSound('play');

      const aiSeats = [1, 2, 3];
      const responder = aiSeats[Math.floor(Math.random() * aiSeats.length)];

      setTimeout(async () => {
        if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
        if (GAME.gameSpeed === 'fast') {
          showSpeech(responder, getAISpeakReplyToUser(text));
        } else {
          await aiSpeak(responder, `玩家对你说："${text}"，请你根据人设做出简短回应（15字以内）。`);
        }
      }, 900);
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-quick-speak').onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const menu = document.getElementById('quick-speak-menu');
      menu.classList.toggle('show');
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('.quick-speak-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const text = btn.getAttribute('data-text');
        document.getElementById('quick-speak-menu').classList.remove('show');
        onUserQuickSpeak(text);
      };
    });

    /* =========================================================
       15. 节奏切换 / 表情互动 / 结算按钮
       ========================================================= */
    document.getElementById('btn-speed-toggle').onclick = function() {
      if (GAME.gameSpeed === 'immersive') {
        GAME.gameSpeed = 'fast';
        this.innerText = "⚡ 节奏: 快节奏";
        showToast("已切换到快速模式：使用内置快捷发言，节奏更快");
      } else {
        GAME.gameSpeed = 'immersive';
        this.innerText = "💬 节奏: 互动沉浸";
        showToast("已切换到沉浸模式：调用 AI 大模型生成台词");
      }
    };

    let activeReactSeat = null;
    document.querySelectorAll('.player-seat .avatar-wrapper').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const seat = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-seat'), 10);
        activeReactSeat = seat;
        const pop = document.getElementById('react-popover');
        const seatEl = el.closest('.player-seat');
        if (!seatEl) return;
        seatEl.appendChild(pop);
        pop.classList.add('show');
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.react-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const emoji = btn.getAttribute('data-emoji');
        const pop = document.getElementById('react-popover');
        pop.classList.remove('show');
        if (activeReactSeat === null) return;

        const seatIdx = activeReactSeat;
        const seatEl = document.getElementById('seat-' + (seatIdx === 0 ? 'player' : seatIdx === 1 ? 'left' : seatIdx === 2 ? 'top' : 'right'));

        if (seatEl) {
          const avatarBox = seatEl.querySelector('.avatar-wrapper');
          if (avatarBox) {
            const burst = document.createElement('div');
            burst.className = 'burst-emoji';
            burst.innerText = emoji;
            avatarBox.appendChild(burst);
            setTimeout(() => burst.remove(), 1300);
          }
        }

        if (seatIdx !== 0 && GAME.gameActive) {
          setTimeout(async () => {
            if (!GAME.gameActive) return;
            if (GAME.gameSpeed === 'fast') {
              showSpeech(seatIdx, getEmojiReply(emoji));
            } else {
              await aiSpeak(seatIdx, `玩家对你发了一个 ${emoji} 表情，请你根据人设做出简短反应（15字以内）。`);
            }
          }, 700);
        }

        activeReactSeat = null;
      };
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const pop = document.getElementById('react-popover');
      if (pop) pop.classList.remove('show');
      activeReactSeat = null;

      const qMenu = document.getElementById('quick-speak-menu');
      const qBtn = document.getElementById('btn-quick-speak');
      if (qMenu && qBtn && !qMenu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== qBtn) {
        qMenu.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('btn-restart').onclick = () => {
      document.getElementById('modal-gameover').style.display = 'none';
      startGame();
    };
    document.getElementById('btn-change-chars').onclick = () => {
      document.getElementById('modal-gameover').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('modal-intro').style.display = 'flex';
    };
    document.getElementById('btn-confirm-start').onclick = startGame;

    initHostServices();
  </script>
